about: Spec 011's answer key, written by hand from spec.md, teaching-design.md and the declared values in mentor/dev/build-practice-comp-2b.jsx and build-overlaps-b.jsx (never by running mentor/lib/anchor.mjs). Times in seconds at 30 fps. 'times' is the --times list each Mentor Practice 2 capture needs in the sitting (research R4). T234 (2026-10-26) checked every value against the live captures of the 2026-10-26 sitting (specs/011-anchor/live-sitting-2026-10-26.md); every value the live comp shows differently has a 'note' next to it, or in 'live_notes'. Ranks and needed times are FR-004's and R4's rules applied by hand to the captured raw facts (keys, parents, rectangles), with shapes as default candidates since L-1 (SHAPES_DEFAULT true).

times.why: The --times list every Mentor Practice 2 capture was taken with: Gauge's rest key (3.167, Rotation 0), Pop's (4.3, full size), Sled's Position keys (3.667, 4.167, 4.667) and Gradient's (5.433, 6.433)
times.needed_note: T246 (D-4), by hand: the 16 Position-keyed layers (Card, Dot 1 to 3, Chip A to C, Flag, Pause, Sled, Tile, Stamp, Row A, Row C, Plate, Gradient) each have Position keys at two or more times (their position_times above), so they're never (position_moves) and drop out with their Position key times and Card's and Tile's rest keys (2.4, 5.367). What's left are the rest keys of the layers with Rotation or Scale keys and no Position keys: Spinner 0.25 (Rotation 0), Gauge 3.167 (Rotation 0), Pop 4.3 (largest Scale), Badge 4.5 (largest Scale). 4 times, down from 30. No layer left in a lesson's reach has Position keys, so none adds a time. The captures hold 3.167 and 4.3 (the --times list) but not 0.25 or 4.5 on every layer, so a lesson start on this comp still reads twice, with 4 times instead of 30. Before T246: T234, live: the live Mentor Practice 2 has 40 layers, not the stand-in's wave B 19, so what neededTimes() asks for is longer than the --times list. By hand, every layer that isn't structurally never (all but Wobble, Hatch Rig, Seal): rest keys Spinner 0.25 (Rotation 0), Card 2.4 (largest Scale), Badge 4.5, Gauge 3.167, Pop 4.3, Tile 5.367; Position keys Card 1.2, 2.4; Dot 1 0, 0.5, 1.5; Dot 2 0.5, 1.5; Dot 3 0.5, 1.25, 1.5; Chip A to C 2, 3; Flag 4, 4.5, 5.5; Pause 5, 5.5, 6, 6.5; Sled 3.667, 4.167, 4.667; Tile 4.167, 5.167; Stamp 4.667, 5.667; Row A 4.8, 5.8; Row C 5.167, 6.167; Plate 5.3, 6.3; Gradient 5.433, 6.433. 30 times, under the 63 cap. The captures hold the --times list, comp.time and each layer's own key times, so a lesson on this comp takes a second read (R4)

practice2b.proposal_note: T241 (spec 011 FR-004, amended 2026-10-26): Door, middle-left, as the quickstart expects. The ranking now has three animation steps after unparented: no keyed property at all, then keys but none on Rotation or Scale, then Rotation or Scale keys. Door (index 14, a 300 x 500 solid, no keys, unparented, pivot at its centre) is the first unkeyed layer by layer order, and it isn't tall (500 is less than twice 300), so it turns from the middle of its left edge. Blink, Cut and Caption (Opacity keys only) drop to the second step. T234 had Blink first

Dot 3.position_times_why: separated: X keys at 0.5 and 1.5, Y keys at 0.5 and 1.25, counted together

Lid.outside_side_why: T242 (FR-019a), by hand: anchor [0, 150] is 120 px below the rectangle's bottom edge (30) and level with its middle across, at Scale 100 and Rotation 0, so on screen it's below
Lid.note: T234 (L-1): was if_named, shape_until_l1. A default candidate now; its anchor isn't at its centre or [0, 0], so it ranks after every unkeyed layer whose pivot is where AE put it

Sled.note: T246 (D-4): was if_named, position_keyed. Three Position key times, so it already moves and is left out with TD § 4's sentence

Stamp.position_times_why: separated: X and Y both keyed at 4.667 and 5.667, so two times, not four

practice2b.ranking_why: FR-004 as amended 2026-10-26 (T241): unparented first (Hatch, Shadow below); then how animated already, three steps: no keyed property at all (Door, Needle, Lid, Tab, Peg, Banner, Sign, Plaque, Row B), then keys but none on Rotation or Scale (Blink, Cut and Caption: Opacity keys), then Rotation or Scale keys (Spinner, Badge, Gauge, Pop); then a pivot where AE put it (Lid, at [0, 150] on a rectangle centred on [0, 0], below the other unkeyed ones); then layer order. Flip is flipped, so it ranks last (row 18). Ranks 1 to 19 by hand from the captured keys and parents, as spec FR-004 lists them. T234 had Blink 1 to Lid 12 with two steps

Orbit.why: T246 (D-4): was cant_read (auto-orient: comp-space returns auto_orient). Three Position key times put it in never by its keys first, before its footprint is read; row 29 keeps the auto_orient path on an unkeyed layer

Locked Bar.why: T246 (D-4): was if_named, locked. Position keys at 3 and 4, and never outranks allowed-if-named: unlocked, it still couldn't pass. Row 28's locked case uses door-locked

Still.note: T234, live (spec 004's layer-info/overlaps.json): was 1. Photo (index 2) and Drift (11) come first by layer order; all three are unparented, unkeyed, pivot at the centre

Drift.why: an expression on unkeyed Position isn't read (R2); the check reads its rendered values

Leaf 2.why: T246 (D-4), by its own key count: X keyed at 0 and 1, Y keyed at 0 and 1, counted together, two times

Wipe.why: T246 (D-4): was if_named, matte. Position keys at 0.6 and 1.6; never outranks allowed-if-named. The matte case uses Mentor Practice 2's Reveal Matte (no keys)

Photo.note: T234, live: was 3; first by layer order (index 2)

door-outside.outside_side_why: T242 (FR-019a), by hand: anchor [-200, 250] is 200 px left of the rectangle's left edge (0) and level with its middle (250 of 500), at Scale 100 and Rotation 0

lid-group.note: T243 (FR-019b): hints outside, then unchanged_shape (Lid is a shape, not passed, its own Anchor Point and Position unchanged, item 2 holds, no other layer's anchor changed). T234, live (L-1): was hints group_anchor. AE moved the group's own Anchor and Position together, so the rectangle didn't shift in layer space and the snapshot strict-matches the base: nothing this skill reads changed. Lid's own pivot is still where it was, outside the shape, so the check says outside

pop-shrunk.item3_now_why: T246: the capture's own comp.time, 3.3 (TD § 7's Pop line says 3.3 s; the capture's comp.time is 3.3)
pop-shrunk.outside_side_why: T242 (FR-019a), by hand: at 4.3 s, full size, Position [120, 960] puts the rectangle at 0 to 120 across and 0 to 120 down on screen, and the anchor at [120, 960]: far below, and level with the right edge (not past it), so below
pop-shrunk.note: T234, live (L-4): AE set Pop's anchor to [120, 960] (Pop's Position read as a layer point), not the stand-in's [60, 120], with Position unchanged. Nothing shows at 3.3 s; at full size Pop draws far off its place, its pivot far outside it. The check grades it set away from rest (item 3) and the one hint is away_from_rest; item 1 reads outside, which the hint order doesn't add

sled-one-key.why: T246 (D-4), by hand from the two captures: Sled has one Position key, at 3.667, and no Rotation or Scale keys, so it's allowed if named and the tip names 3.667. The check time is the base's own time, 0. Pan Behind at 0 set the anchor from [50, 30] to [0, 30] (the middle of the left edge of its 100 x 60 rectangle, item 1) and added a Position key at 0 of [270, 960], so at 0 its left edge stays at 270 (item 2 holds). At 3.667 the old key still says [320, 960] while the anchor is [0, 30], so the left edge is at 320, 50 px right of where it was: item 4 fails there, and the added key is an other change

sled-slid.outside_lesson_path: T246 (D-4): Sled has three Position key times, so a lesson never reaches it (it's never, position_moves). Kept as item 4's unit test on three keys, with the check called on Sled as its target directly
sled-slid.note: T234, live (L-2): AE added a Position key at frame 0 (the playhead) and left the three keys as they were; the stand-in guessed it rewrote the first. Sled holds still at 0 s and slides the same 50 px at every old key, so the worst key is the first one, 3.667, and the added key is an other change

sled-on-key.outside_lesson_path: T246 (D-4): as sled-slid, a lesson never reaches it; item 4's unit test only, the check called on Sled directly
sled-on-key.note: T234, live extra (L-2): the playhead on the first key (3.667). AE rewrote only that key; the other two stay, so Sled slides 50 px at 4.167 and 4.667 and no key is added. The baseline is the live base with its playhead at 3.667, where the learner started (the base holds samples there)

demo-separated-xy.note: T234, live extra (L-4): the demo on Tab with Position separated, written as X and Y. The read can't tell separated from not, and the check passes it the same way

sled_with_door.why: T246 (D-4): Sled is refused (three Position key times, never), so Door is the only target and the analysis names it; with one target the session's single-target rule then gives no demo. Was: Sled isn't a default candidate (Position keyed), so the demo goes on entry 0

lid_with_banner.note: T234 (L-1): was null with not_a_default_candidate; shapes are default candidates now, so Banner (entry 1) takes the demo

matte_with_background.why: T246 (D-4): replaces sled_with_gradient (both are never now, so neither is a target). Picked by hand: Reveal Matte is if_named (matte) and Background if_named (full_frame); both pivots are at their centres ([120, 70] on 240 x 140, [960, 540] on 1920 x 1080), so neither is already at the middle of its left edge and both are targets. Neither is a default candidate, so no demo

live_notes.hatch-rig-focus: Hatch Rig's anchor moved from [0, 0] to [50, 50] with Pan Behind (Position by the same), so neither it nor Hatch moved on screen
live_notes.sign-left: Sign left-justified: its letters' rectangle starts 2.455 px right of its pivot (the log rounds it to 2.45) (the stand-in had 0), and the pivot is on the baseline, so it reads between places. Centred, the rectangle is 145.628 wide from -73.393 (the stand-in had 128 from -64). L-5: within 1 px of the ink both ways

Sign is text, so unchanged_shape doesn't fire
